youtube.title: Did You Know About IBM's $5 Billion AI Unlock? 🚀
youtube.description:
IBM and Red Hat just dropped a $5 billion bombshell with their investment in Project Lightwell, making cutting-edge AI models fully open source. What does this mean for you? No more vendor lock-in or proprietary constraints. It's like owning the car instead of renting it every time you need a ride.

Imagine running a million inferences without worrying about huge token fees. With Lightwell, you control everything: infrastructure, weights, deployment, and runtime. Red Hat's got the orchestration covered, whether you're on-prem, multi-cloud, or air-gapped.

It's a game-changer for anyone tired of paying sky-high API costs. Why rent when you can own?

Comment LIGHTWELL below, and I'll send over a handy deployment comparison chart.

linkedin.text:
Five billion dollars just shifted the AI landscape. 

IBM and Red Hat are unlocking the door to open-source AI with their massive investment in Project Lightwell. It’s like they've handed you the keys to a high-performance car.

If you're building with AI, your stack just got an upgrade. No more vendor lock-in or hidden fees. Instead, you get full control over your infrastructure and deployments. 

It's a stark contrast to providers that charge per token and keep all the weights to themselves.

Imagine the power of running inferences without asking for permission or paying each time. 

I made a short video about this, showing what you can do now with Lightwell.

What's your take on this shift? 

#ibm #opensource #cloudcomputing #ai #innovation
